p5: The Sub-Fund is positioned to withstand a broad range of different environments, and our approach is always to remain patient and lean into risk when we are rewarded to do so.

manager_thesis_and_decisions.format_clue: Narrative text in the 'Portfolio Review' section of the Investment Manager's report, detailing additions, new holdings, and exits with rationale for each decision.
manager_thesis_and_decisions.evidence_quote:
p5: Within the equity component of the portfolio, we added to existing holdings in Agilent Technologies, Alphabet, Chubb and Diageo and established new holdings in Adobe, L’Oréal, Hubbell, Canadian National Railway, LSEG and LVMH.
p6: We exited Procter & Gamble (P&G) and Moody’s because of uncertainties about future growth in earnings, and the risk to current valuations.
